title: Schedule B: Agreement Terms, Review Levels and Notice Periods of Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements
content:
**Schedule B to the Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements terms.** For each tier the schedule fixes six figures:

1. the agreement term — the calendar months of one agreement term, counted from approval;
2. the retention percentage — the share of the tier's annual spend threshold that keeps the tier at the agreement-year review, as a whole percent;
3. the tier drop limit — the most tiers an agreement falls at one review;
4. the review period — the calendar days from the opening of a review to its decision;
5. the termination notice — the calendar days of notice the company must give to terminate before the term ends;
6. the post-termination redemption period — the calendar days after termination during which remaining company points may still be redeemed.

| Tier | Agreement term (months) | Retention percentage | Tier drop limit (tiers) | Review period (calendar days) | Termination notice (calendar days) | Post-termination redemption (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Business Connect | 12 | 0 | 1 | 30 | 0 | 90 |
| Crestline Business Connect Plus | 12 | 80 | 1 | 30 | 30 | 90 |
| Crestline Corporate Select | 24 | 80 | 1 | 45 | 60 | 90 |
| Crestline Corporate Preferred | 24 | 80 | 1 | 60 | 90 | 90 |
| Crestline Corporate Premier | 36 | 85 | 1 | 60 | 90 | 90 |
| Crestline Corporate Strategic | 36 | 90 | 1 | 90 | 120 | 90 |

### Notes to the schedule

- **Retention level in dollars.** The retention level is the retention percentage applied to the tier's own annual spend threshold. For a hypothetical threshold of USD 100000, a retention percentage of 80 gives a retention level of USD 80000, and 90 gives USD 90000.
- **Drop limit.** Every tier carries a drop limit of 1, so at any one review an agreement moves down by at most one tier.
- **Zero notice.** Crestline Business Connect carries a termination notice of 0 calendar days; every other tier carries a positive notice period.
- **Months and days.** The agreement term is counted in calendar months; the review period, the termination notice and the post-termination redemption period are counted in calendar days.
